prompt: A prime-time adult animated sitcom background: flat colours and slightly wobbly black outlines, every colour laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Looking steeply down from the edge of a rooftop past a rusty parapet and pipes in the near foreground, into a narrow 1930s American street at night, the street running away diagonally into the distance: soot-black brick walls and iron fire escapes on both sides, wet cobbles below, completely empty and still, a forgotten red scarf and a blue scarf lying in a puddle. In another puddle on the cobbles, the only sign of the sky: the reflection of a small, perfectly round, solid red moon. One window glows candle yellow; from a pavement grating far down the street, a faint emerald glow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
